paper.title: Basis-free neural-network geminal and Jastrow factors for variational Monte Carlo

results.system_description: H₄, rectangle, 2.188 × 2.4 bohr, all electrons, singlet (2 up, 2 down), clamped nuclei
results.variant: NNWF(P): neural-network AGP with pairing neural Jastrow factor
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the optimized neural-network wavefunction as printed.
results.notes: Rectangular H4 with r_y = 2.4 bohr and r_x = 2.188 bohr (Sec. on H4: the two H2 pairs are separated by r_y, r_x is the distance in the x direction); the coordinates are the corners of the rectangle. N_up = N_down = 2: an antisymmetrized geminal power of singlet pairs. The JAGP columns are conventional (non-neural) wavefunctions.
